items.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He gets to Porky Cohen... Sal Detor had blond, and Eddie King, blond hair, blue eyes. He said, “You colored?” And he said, “Yes.”

ctx.x: I talked with Eddie Bert, who was often the only white player in black bands.
That’s right. He’s a very dear friend of mine too, Eddie.
Yeah. He’s a wonderful guy. I interviewed him, and he said that it was interesting, because to him, “We were all just musicians.”
